title: Understanding Content Moderation in Large Language Models through Restricted Books: From Refusal to Warning

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model warning and hesitation rates when prompted about culturally contested (restricted/challenged) books versus unrestricted canonical books in the United States, evaluating how models encode specific cultural norms of controversy.

Analyzing whether models disproportionately flag or mention LGBTQ+ themes in responses about restricted books compared to unrestricted books, measuring the exaggeration of this association (representativeness heuristic).
Measuring and comparing the mention rates of race and racism topics in model responses when queried about restricted versus unrestricted books.
Measuring and comparing the mention rates of religious topics in model responses when queried about restricted versus unrestricted books.
